item.tib: srid pa las kyi gting bzlog gi rtsa rgyud nyi zer sgron ma
item.coloph: rgyud sde bzhi ni/ theg dgu spyi la rgyug pas/ spyi rgyug kun gsal sgron ma zhes bya ba/ theg sgo'i spyi gcod/ don gyi mdo rtsa/ spyi spungs rgyud dgu'i spyi sdom/ yang snying gting bzlog gi rtsa rgyud/ tsong ka skad nyan mtsho nag la sbas te/ rma pom ra/ mtsho sman mched bdun/ klu bdud mgo dgu la gter bsrungs bkod/ gter ston grub thob bra bo bsgom nyag gis dngos grub lags so//
